subject: Renewal + capacity amendment — procurement portal intake and signoff
messages:
From: Daniel Hsu <daniel.hsu@northbridge.ai>
To: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@northbridge.ai
Date: Thu, 28 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal terms & one-time capacity add — procurement portal intake

Hi Laura,

Hope you're well. Our renewal for Redwood is coming up on 2028-07-15 and the business has asked to add one additional dedicated GPU unit for three months (trial to support a proof-of-concept). We need to get procurement aligned so the new term and one-time capacity charge are accepted and a PO is issued before month-end.

Can you confirm:
- Do you need a PO or is the portal purchase flow sufficient?
- If PO required, will Redwood accept our standard PO template (attached for reference)?
- Any updated SOW to reflect the extra capacity and term change?

We'd like to avoid delaying the July ramp. Happy to get on a short call if helpful.

Thanks,
Daniel Hsu
Sourcing Manager, Northbridge AI
procurement@northbridge.ai

Attachments: PO_template_Northbridge.xlsx (stub)

From: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Daniel Hsu <daniel.hsu@northbridge.ai>
Cc: aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, procurement@northbridge.ai
Date: Thu, 28 Jun 2028 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal terms & one-time capacity add — procurement portal intake

Hi Daniel — thanks for the heads up.

Short answers up front: we can accept either a PO or your portal purchase path. For speed, we typically create a portal request and attach an amended SOW; if you prefer a PO we can route it to finance and get it processed.

I've looped in Aditya (your account exec) and Neha (customer success) to coordinate pricing and the SOW changes. Aditya — could you confirm the final line-item pricing for the additional GPU unit and whether we can offer a one-time onboarding credit for the trial period? Neha — please note the requested start date target 2028-07-01.

I've prepared a draft SOW (Redwood_SOW_v2.pdf) that updates the billing cadence and adds the three-month unit. I'll attach it to the portal ticket once we confirm pricing.

Next step: Aditya will confirm pricing & any approval needed from Marissa; once approved I'll create POR-124589 in the portal and attach the SOW and PO template.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Director, Renewal Ops
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_SOW_v2.pdf (stub)

From: aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 28 Jun 2028 11:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal terms & one-time capacity add — procurement portal intake

Laura / Marissa —

Pricing for the extra dedicated GPU unit is $16,500/month. For the three-month trial we can offer a one-time $6,000 onboarding credit (applied on final invoice) to keep AR reasonable during the trial. That falls inside the tiered discount band we discussed last quarter, but I want quick approval on the credit before I confirm with the customer.

Marissa — can you approve the credit? If not, we can negotiate terms with Daniel but trying to keep the PO size stable.

For legal redlines: the SOW only contains the capacity line and billing schedule; if procurement sends redlines we'll route to legal but this SOW is standard.

Thanks,
Aditya
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: legal-team <legal@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 28 Jun 2028 15:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal terms & one-time capacity add — procurement portal intake

Aditya — approved. The $6k one-time credit is authorized for NWBR-2028-Q2-EXP-47. Please note finance needs the PO to match the attached template fields (billing address, remit-to, and P.O. number). Laura — once the portal request PR-124589 is created, please include a copy of the PO or the portal confirmation screenshot for the invoice team.

Legal — please keep an eye for any procurement redlines; if they change indemnity or data-treatment clauses we need to escalate.

Marissa Cole
VP Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

From: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Daniel Hsu <daniel.hsu@northbridge.ai>
Cc: aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, procurement@northbridge.ai
Date: Sat, 30 Jun 2028 17:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal terms & one-time capacity add — procurement portal intake

Daniel — thanks for moving quickly. Portal ticket created: POR-124589 (https://portal.redwood.ai/requests/POR-124589). I attached the updated SOW (Redwood_SOW_v2.pdf) and your PO template to the portal. Summary of next steps and timeline: 

- Pricing confirmed: $16,500/month for additional dedicated GPU unit; one-time $6,000 onboarding credit approved (Marissa).
- Portal ticket: POR-124589 created and routed to Finance & Procurement ops.
- If you prefer to sign a PO, please upload the completed PO (PO_template_Northbridge.xlsx) to the portal and mark the ticket "PO attached". Finance will match fields and issue invoice.
- If there are any legal redlines, please put them in the portal comments. Our legal team will triage and respond within 48 business hours.
- DocuSign: we'll route the SOW for signature if needed — link will be posted in the portal (https://docusign.com/abc123-redwood-northbridge).

Target start date: 2028-07-01, pending PO or portal approval by 2028-06-30 close of business. If the PO will be delayed beyond that, let me know immediately so we can stage capacity.

Thanks again — happy to hop on a 15m call Monday if you'd like to finalize.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Director, Renewal Ops
Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0187
